claims.text: Johnson's post of 2 July 2014 is the only opened description of the video said to contain an admission, and it records that he could not verify it: 'The video is about an alleged Skype conversation with Edgar Fouche, but I could not see the screen clearly enough in Hilton's video to verify the claims he was making.' It also establishes that the video is David Hilton's and not Jeremy Rys's.

title: Andrew Johnson, 'Keeping The Secret Space Programme a Secret'
